query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 80,
  radar_freshness = 20,
  radar_warmth = 80,
  radar_sweetness = 15,
  radar_spiciness = 55,
  radar_earthiness = 70
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%fumé%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%smoke%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%cuir%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%leather%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%tabac%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%tobacco%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
